median_dom.definition: Median number of days between the initial listing date and the date a home went under contract in Redfin's rolling three-month window.
median_dom.label: Median days on market

median_sale_ppsf.definition: Median closed sale price divided by square footage for homes sold in Redfin's rolling three-month window.
median_sale_ppsf.label: Median sale price per square foot

months_supply.definition: Active inventory divided by the average monthly pace of closed sales in Redfin's rolling three-month window.
months_supply.label: Months of supply

price_drop_share.definition: Share of active listings with at least one asking-price reduction during Redfin's rolling three-month window.
price_drop_share.label: Active listings with price drops

sold_above_original_share.definition: Share of closed sales whose sale price exceeded the home's original list price in Redfin's rolling three-month window.
sold_above_original_share.label: Homes sold above original list
